answers.value: For each tax-paying component in each tax jurisdiction, all deferred tax assets (net of any valuation allowance) and all deferred tax liabilities are offset and reported as a single net amount; that net deferred tax asset or liability is classified entirely as noncurrent on the classified balance sheet. DTAs and DTLs of different components or different jurisdictions may not be offset against each other.
